newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu rises after news of engine talks with GM.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu rises after news of engine talks with GM.

text.p: Shares in Isuzu Motors Ltd rose in Friday morning trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) after the company said it was negotiating to sell newly developed engines to General Motors Corp.
Isuzu ended the morning session up 52 yen, or 10.3 percent, at 557 yen. It was the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the TSE.
An Isuzu spokesman told Reuters earlier on Friday that the company had developed fuel-efficient 2,500 cc and 3,000 cc diesel engines and that it was negotiating to sell the new engines to GM.
He said Isuzu expected GM to buy the engines, although nothing had yet been decided.
